notes.title: New Demo, New Trailer, Monster Taming Direct!
notes.content:
Hello!

Lots of progress has been made during development of Pry Into The Void, and I believe I needed a new demo that reflected those improvements!

Previously the demo had reported issues with running on Steam Deck, I am glad to announce that those issues have been squashed! Please enjoy the demo on your Steam Deck in all its glory!

Furthermore, the demo just exudes general polish, and new features such as Battle Challenges. Every battle provides a random challenge which rewards you with items, money or experience!
This adds an extra dimension to your mundane regular JRPG battles while providing an extra challenge to your bosses!


The demo also adds an extra key cutscene that provides more character depth to the start of the game!
The new demo is available to download and play now, so please enjoy!

Pry Into The Void also once again participated in Monster Taming Direct, a yearly showcase of monster taming games that is now 3 years in the running.
You can check out the archive of the event here:
[previewyoutube=Bjca8IIu0YQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We participated with a new trailer showing new monsters and new scenes.
Check it out here:
[previewyoutube=DtbB6CkVAuA;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyways, development is slowly getting there. Not too much left to go.
Seriously, thank you to everyone who has supported the project this far!
See you in the depths of the Void.

- Ernest Placido

notes.title: Publisher Announcement, Monster Taming Direct and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been crazy lately for Pry Into The Void!

In July, Pry Into The Void revealed its publishing deal with Dangen Entertainment - publisher of games such as Bug Fables, Ara Fell, Abomi Nation and more! Very happy that PitV is part of the Dangen line up as I've always respected the publisher's choice of games to sign with. This opportunity also opens up many possibilities such as language options (including Japanese) and console versions later down the line! I'm excited to have more and more people join Josef's descent into the Void!

Check out the announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=WwVMkF-Yohg;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://youtu.be/DBLZV_PPGzs?si=kc_viP_RQ4RXL3kb]Click here for the Japanese version.[/url]

In August, PitV also participated in the second Monster Taming Direct hosted by Gym Leader Ed and Bandit Berry.
A new trailer premiered during the event titled "Waltiere Trailer", focused on the character Waltiere who represents one of the 3 routes of the game.
The trailer also showcases the first vocal track of Pry Into The Void, Waltiere's theme composed by Jun Mitsui with lyrics and vocals from Brandon Yates. It's so freaking awesome, you have to check out the trailer yourselves!

Here's the Waltiere trailer!

[previewyoutube=0h7fydsz2vY;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://youtu.be/BOGNIkWVpVQ]Click here for the Japanese version.[/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/pgSRTnnlqEk?si=RqIt_CDP9IARUSdn]And click here to watch the full Monster Taming Direct 2023 on Gym Leader Ed's channel![/url]

Game progress has been nice and steady! 
Looking forward to sharing more story and gameplay details in future trailers!

This journey still has a ways to go.
May we meet again in the depths of the Void.

- Ernest Placido
